shared_elements: row of repeated animals facing the same direction, overlapping
human body parts (arms/hands in A, arms and legs of figures in B)
low-relief figures set against a plain ground
justification: Both show profile quadrupeds arranged in a repeated, same-facing row overlapping one another, with human limbs appearing alongside the animals, which is a real if fairly common correspondence. The manner of depiction differs sharply: A's creatures are flat, schematic silhouettes stacked in multiple registers with mixed species (canids, bird, snake-like forms and disembodied arms), whereas B gives anatomically modelled horned rams with textured fleece and volumetric legs in a single processional band led by human attendants.
